title: Character (an agent-bearer carrying a stable disposition)
description: A character is a stable articulation: a persistent agent that bears a disposition. The disposition is a nucleus χ on its behavioral fiber — idempotent, monotone, inflationary — whose fixed set Fix(χ) is the behavioral space it endorses; 'in character' is χ(a)=a. The persona/character/role triad: role = capability-signature (what it MAY do — external capability references), character = the nucleus χ (HOW), persona = the entity bearing it. This schema is the serializable character: role + persona + the endorsed set that generates χ. The nucleus itself is reconstructed by characterizing's chiOf/inCharacter helpers (χ(S) = S ∪ endorse), not stored. Codomain of characterizing.

role.description: the role: a capability-signature naming what the character MAY do (external capability references, like tool names)

persona.description: the entity bearing the character (a reference), or null if unbound

endorse.description: the endorsed behaviors generating the nucleus χ(S) = S ∪ endorse; Fix(χ) = behavior sets containing endorse
